$comment: Policy for tools/quality/audit_api_evidence.py (v2.4.0 T0.3). Proposed example-eligibility rules for gate G3. An exported class is example-eligible unless a rule below exempts it. Every rule states why; T3.2 turns accepted rules into per-record example_exempt/example_exempt_reason fields in doc/api_registry.json and this file then shrinks.

exempt_header_prefixes.disp/viewers/: Qt widget or view; evidenced by a screenshot scenario and GUI test (G4), not by a compiled console example.
exempt_header_prefixes.disp3D/model/: Scene-graph item owned and driven by BrainView; not constructed directly by library users.
exempt_header_prefixes.disp3D/workers/: Background worker owned by a real-time view; its behaviour is exercised through the owning view.
exempt_header_prefixes.disp3D/core/: Renderer internals behind the BrainView/MultimodalScene facade.
exempt_header_prefixes.disp3D/geometry/: Renderer internals behind the BrainView/MultimodalScene facade.
exempt_header_prefixes.disp3D/input/: Interaction handler of an interactive view; evidenced by GUI tests.
exempt_header_prefixes.com/rt_client/: Requires a running mne_rt_server; evidenced by integration tests rather than a runnable example.
exempt_header_prefixes.com/rt_command/: Requires a running mne_rt_server; evidenced by integration tests rather than a runnable example.

exempt_name_suffixes.Private: Implementation detail behind a public facade.
exempt_name_suffixes.Delegate: Qt item delegate; only meaningful inside a view.
exempt_name_suffixes.Settings: Plain parameter record consumed by an algorithm class; shown inside that class's example.
